headline: Fed +25bp to 3.75-4%, 16 of 18 see another this year, S&P futures +0.74%, DXY 100.33
stance: The hike is done and the dots point to another by December. The curve flattened on the front end, not the long end.

news.head: Fed hikes 25bp, Warsh hawkish
news.body: Target range 3.75-4.00% on a 12-0 vote, the first hike since July 2023. Warsh called inflation too high and conditions not restrictive enough.

news.head: Dots put one more hike in 2026
news.body: 16 of 18 participants see at least one more 25bp move this year. Four pencil in two. Meetings left: October and December.

news.head: Futures higher pre-market
news.body: Dow futures +0.66%, S&P 500 +0.74%, Nasdaq-100 +0.96% (4:45am ET). Equities are taking back Wednesday's decline.

news.head: Dollar at a seven-week high
news.body: DXY 100.33 overnight (4:45am ET), up 0.7%. Yen and euro both gave ground as the front end repriced.

implications: Financial conditions are the target now, not the funds rate. Warsh said they are not restrictive enough at 3.75-4.00%.
Hawkish dots with two meetings left make October live. Claims at 8:30 start the data that decides it.

watch.head: Bank of England, 7:00am
watch.body: Rate decision with a split MPC vote. A hold is expected; the question is whether energy prices force a November hike.

watch.head: Jobless claims, 8:30
watch.body: Weekly initial claims. First labor read since the decision; the four-week average sat at 206K on September 5.

watch.head: Philadelphia Fed survey, 8:30
watch.body: September manufacturing outlook, with prices paid the line that matters now.

watch.head: Housing starts and permits, 8:30
watch.body: August new residential construction. The rate-sensitive read into a Fed that just hiked and signalled more.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Wednesday's repricing was all front end; the long end went the other way. A hike the market believes flattens, it does not steepen.
Breakevens fell, real yields rose. That is credibility, priced in one session.
Rate vol released after the decision; equity vol did not. The bond market got its answer, stocks got a new question.
sections.positioning: 3M SOFR specs sit at the 1st percentile, a 3-year low, and have for 21 weeks. Nobody in that market is positioned for cuts.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Wednesday's selling was Dow-led; the Nasdaq-100 finished flat. Cyclicals took the hike, megacap tech did not.
Megacap tech leads the pre-market bounce. Decision risk is off the board until October.
sections.positioning: Russell 2000 specs sit at the 2nd percentile, an extended short standing 20 weeks. Small caps are the most rate-sensitive index into a hiking Fed.

single_name.note: Flotek Industries: insider buy filed Tuesday, trades above its 200-day, 3.9 days to cover. Second session on the scan.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: High yield widened two straight sessions while investment grade has not moved in four. The repricing is all low-quality.
Credit is still marked to Tuesday, before the decision. Thursday's runs are the first post-hike read on spreads.
The Treasury account drew down in early September. Reserves added while the Fed tightens the price of money.

ideas.line: 5 open · 1 closed — no hit rate until 10 (too few to mean anything)
